g.text: AC/OP bias only (faq): R1,R2 CM-average -> Bhelp -> Rhelp ; C7,C8 = C_C sense/hold
Cs1,Cs2 sampled by S1-S4 ; phi1 = sample/reset, phi2 = amplify ; non-overlap 20 MHz
.param W=1u L=0.18u Mp=75 Mn=22 Rn=5.8 Rp=7.5 mp_ratio={Mp/Mn}
OpAmp in Feedback Unloaded for AC sim
.meas AC PM_phase find ph(V(Vinpp,Vinpn)) at BW_cl_open
.meas AC GM_mag find mag(V(Vinpp,Vinpn)) at GM_freq
